newsitem.title: USA: Sports Club will pay $1.95 mln in settlement.
newsitem.headline: Sports Club will pay $1.95 mln in settlement.

text.p: Sports Club Co Inc said Thursday it has agreed to pay Century Entertainment Center LP $1.95 million to settle litigation but said the payment will not impact its operating income.
The company said the the payment will be made during a 10-month period out of existing working capital and will be accounted for as an extraordinary charge to earnings.
The company said the settlement relates to the Century City Spectrum Club, which was closed in July 1995.
The Sports Club operates health and fitness clubs under the Sports Club and Spectrum Club names.
